title: Maula Madine Wale
body:
Maula Madine Wale
<<DIVIDER>>
Jin Ka Nana NABI (SAWW)
Jin Ka Baba ALI (AS)
Jin Ki Maa FATEMA (SA)
Jin Ka Bhai HASAN (AS)
Woh Hai Maula Hamare HUSAIN (AS).....2
<<MINI>>
Maula Madine Wale.....4
Karbal Mein Aa Gaie Hai, Karbal Basane Wale
Maula Madine Wale.....2
Khaime Saja Rahe Hai, Wada Nibha Ne Wale
Maula Madine Wale.....
Karbal Mein Aa Gaie Hai, Karbal Basane Wale

<<DIVIDER>>
1. Yeh Dar Woh Pak Dar Hai, Jo FATEMA (SA) Ka Dar Hai
Yeh Pyare Mustafa (saww), Maula ALI (AS) Ka Dar Hai
Maqtal Mein Aa Gai Hai, Quran Suna Ne Wale
<<MINI>>
Maula Madine Wale.....
Karbal Mein Aa Gaie Hai, Karbal Basane Wale
Maula Madine Wale.....2
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Islam Ne Pukara, Quran Ne Sada Di
Yesrab Ka SHAHZADA (AS), Yesrab Ki SHAHZADI (SA)
Nikle Safar Ko Ghar Se, Kalma Bachane Wale
<<MINI>>
Maula Madine Wale.....
Karbal Mein Aa Gaie Hai, Karbal Basane Wale
Maula Madine Wale.....2
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ro Ro Ke Boli SUGHRA (SA), Dil Doob Ta Hai Mera
Weeran Kiya Madina, Jungle Mein Hai Basera
Mujhko Rulagai Kyun, Khushian Luta Ne Wale
<<MINI>>
Maula Madine Wale.....
Karbal Mein Aa Gaie Hai, Karbal Basane Wale
Maula Madine Wale.....2
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Daamad Ke Dulhare, Beti Ke SHAHZADE (AS)
Yeh Teen Deen Ke Pyaase, Sub Phool MUSTUFA (SAWW) Ke
Katre Ko Hai Yehi To, Daria Banane Wale, Maula Madine Wale.....
<<MINI>>
Karbal Mein Aa Gaie Hai, Karbal Basane Wale
Maula Madine Wale.....2
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Sub Lut Gai Kamaie, AKBAR (AS) Ne Barchi Khai
ASGAR (AS) Ne Teer Khaya, Deti Thi Maan Duhaie
Teeron Ke Saie Mein Hai, Sajde Mein Jane Wale
<<MINI>>
Maula Madine Wale.....
Karbal Mein Aa Gaie Hai, Karbal Basane Wale
Maula Madine Wale.....2
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Halmin Ka Istegasa Jub De Chuka Woh Pyasa
Aawaz E Irjaie Ne Aa Kar Diya Dilasa
Aa Mere Paas Aaja, Lashe Utha Ne Wale
<<MINI>>

Karbal Mein Aa Gaie Hai, Karbal Basane Wale
Maula Madine Wale.....2
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Ek Shor Tha Falaq Par, Kehta Tha Rab E Akbar
Jibril Badalon Ka Jaldi Bichao Bistar
Jannat Mein Aa Rahe Hai Quran Bachane Wale
<<MINI>>
Maula Madine Wale.....
Karbal Mein Aa Gaie Hai, Karbal Basane Wale
Maula Madine Wale.....2
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Salman Aur Shanawar, Khushbakht Ho Aliji
Rehan Ki Tamanna, Sarwar Ki Jo Dua Thi
Khidmat Kabool Karle, Kismat Banane Wale
